title: thelypteris gracilis
intro: Thelypteris gracilis, commonly known as the Slender Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Thelypteris gracilis include its ability to act as an antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, providing therapeutic actions that help in reducing fever, soothing inflammation, and aiding in the expulsion of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
